eyebrow: An Argo CD Application, watching one Helm chart
code:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: checkout
spec:
  source:
    repoURL: https://github.com/northbridgeretail/k8s-manifests.git
    path: charts/checkout
    helm:
      valueFiles: [values-prod.yaml]
  destination:
    namespace: northbridge-retail
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      selfHeal: true
caption: selfHeal: true is what turns drift detection into automatic correction, not just a dashboard warning.
